searchText: Hi, What are the prater explorers? Or there’s only one? (Didnt find others on goerli.net) https://prater.beaconcha.in/ what you're looking for? Yeh that’s the one i know… but want to check it against another one/s. (Also great job on teku!) ah fair, im not sure i know of any others but you can request blocks etc via api pretty reasonably if you're looking at things like block roots... infura has prater configuration, so i use that a bit to get specific things, but no real visualization per-say, all api always happy to hear feedback on teku 🙂 glad you like it 🙂
